text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective method is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This approach helps teams stay focused and know exactly what they need to accomplish. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline that show progress. Deliverables, or the final products or results, should be clearly identified so everyone understands what is expected. Finally, stakeholder alignment is necessary to ensure that everyone involved shares the same vision and supports the project’s objectives. When these elements work together, projects are more likely to succeed.
